anchor.statement: Proposition 8.4. Let ( β , v, γ ) and w be the smooth shell-supported corrections of (8.1). Suppose that the two moments in (8.2) vanish at every (Z, T), and reconstruct p m from their radial source g r by (8.12). For the residual components E θ , E z in (8.3) and the defects J θ , J z , c ρ in (8.15), one has ∫︂ R 2 ⟨E θ ⟩ Y dR = ε∂ Z J θ , ∫︂ R⟨E z ⟩ Y dR = ε∂ Z (J z + c ρ P). (8.16)

correspondence.note: Split into the angular identity ∫R²⟨Eθ⟩Y dR = ε∂Z Jθ and the axial identity ∫R⟨Ez⟩Y dR = ε∂Z(Jz + cρP) with the pressure from the compact primitive (8.12), plus the pressure-moment computation; the balances take the averaged fluxes as general shell-supported inputs, of which (8.3) and (8.15) are the instance.

∀ {a b : ℝ} (ε : ℝ) {v radialFlux axialFlux virtualFlux : NavierStokes.IntegratedMeanBalances.MeanField},
  NavierStokes.IntegratedMeanBalances.SmoothShell a b v →
    NavierStokes.IntegratedMeanBalances.SmoothShell a b radialFlux →
      NavierStokes.IntegratedMeanBalances.SmoothShell a b axialFlux →
        NavierStokes.IntegratedMeanBalances.SmoothShell a b virtualFlux →
          NavierStokes.IntegratedMeanBalances.radialMoment 2 v = 0 →
            ∀ (p : NavierStokes.IntegratedMeanBalances.MeanParameter),
              NavierStokes.IntegratedMeanBalances.radialMoment 2
                  (NavierStokes.IntegratedMeanBalances.angularBalance ε v radialFlux axialFlux virtualFlux) p =
                ε * (fderiv ℝ (NavierStokes.IntegratedMeanBalances.radialMoment 2 axialFlux) p) (0, 1)

links.doc:
The second identity of (34) with pressure supplied by the actual compact
primitive (33). No pressure moment or pressure derivative identity is assumed.
links.name: NavierStokes.IntegratedMeanBalances.integrated_axial_constructed_pressure

conclusion.text:
∫ (r : ℝ) in Set.Ioi 0,
    r *
      NavierStokes.IntegratedMeanBalances.axialBalance ε γ radialFlux axialFlux
        (NavierStokes.IntegratedMeanBalances.reconstructedMeanPressure d a b M hab v f) virtualFlux (r, p) =
  ε *
    (fderiv ℝ
        (fun (q : NavierStokes.IntegratedMeanBalances.MeanParameter) =>
          NavierStokes.IntegratedMeanBalances.axialDefect axialFlux
              (NavierStokes.IntegratedMeanBalances.averagedRadialSource f) q +
            NavierStokes.IntegratedMeanBalances.pressureCoefficient
                (NavierStokes.IntegratedMeanBalances.normalizedMeanDensity a b hab) q *
              NavierStokes.IntegratedMeanBalances.pressureTotal
                (NavierStokes.IntegratedMeanBalances.averagedRadialSource f) q)
        p)
      (0, 1)

∀ {d a b M : ℝ},
  0 < a →
    ∀ (hab : a < b),
      0 < d →
        ∀ (ε : ℝ) (v : ℝ × ℝ)
          {f : NavierStokes.PressureStream.Lift NavierStokes.IntegratedMeanBalances.MeanParameter → ℝ},
          ContDiff ℝ (↑⊤) f →
            NavierStokes.RadialAlias.RadiallySupported a b f →
              NavierStokes.PressureStream.TorusPeriodicLift f →
                ∀ {γ radialFlux axialFlux virtualFlux : NavierStokes.IntegratedMeanBalances.MeanField},
                  NavierStokes.IntegratedMeanBalances.SmoothShell a b γ →
                    NavierStokes.IntegratedMeanBalances.SmoothShell a b radialFlux →
                      NavierStokes.IntegratedMeanBalances.SmoothShell a b axialFlux →
                        NavierStokes.IntegratedMeanBalances.SmoothShell a b virtualFlux →
                          NavierStokes.IntegratedMeanBalances.radialMoment 1 γ = 0 →
                            ∀ (p : NavierStokes.IntegratedMeanBalances.MeanParameter),
                              ∫ (r : ℝ) in Set.Ioi 0,
                                  r *
                                    NavierStokes.IntegratedMeanBalances.axialBalance ε γ radialFlux axialFlux
                                      (NavierStokes.IntegratedMeanBalances.reconstructedMeanPressure d a b M hab v f)
                                      virtualFlux (r, p) =
                                ε *
                                  (fderiv ℝ
                                      (fun (q : NavierStokes.IntegratedMeanBalances.MeanParameter) =>
                                        NavierStokes.IntegratedMeanBalances.axialDefect axialFlux
                                            (NavierStokes.IntegratedMeanBalances.averagedRadialSource f) q +
                                          NavierStokes.IntegratedMeanBalances.pressureCoefficient
                                              (NavierStokes.IntegratedMeanBalances.normalizedMeanDensity a b hab) q *
                                            NavierStokes.IntegratedMeanBalances.pressureTotal
                                              (NavierStokes.IntegratedMeanBalances.averagedRadialSource f) q)
                                      p)
                                    (0, 1)

links.doc:
Exact moment of the constructed compact pressure, including its normalized
mean correction. The derivative used in the proof is a theorem of the actual
physical transport integral, not an assumption here.
links.name: NavierStokes.IntegratedMeanBalances.constructed_pressure_moment

conclusion.text:
(NavierStokes.IntegratedMeanBalances.moment 1 fun (r : ℝ) =>
    NavierStokes.PressureStream.torusAverage (NavierStokes.PressureStream.meanPressure d a b M hab v f) (r, s)) =
  (-(1 / 2) *
      NavierStokes.IntegratedMeanBalances.moment 2 fun (r : ℝ) => NavierStokes.PressureStream.torusAverage f (r, s)) +
    NavierStokes.IntegratedMeanBalances.moment 2 (NavierStokes.PressureStream.rho a b hab) / 2 *
      NavierStokes.PressureStream.pressureMass f s

∀ {S : Type} [inst : NormedAddCommGroup S] [inst_1 : NormedSpace ℝ S] {d a b M : ℝ},
  0 < a →
    ∀ (hab : a < b),
      0 < d →
        ∀ (v : ℝ × ℝ) {f : NavierStokes.PressureStream.Lift S → ℝ},
          ContDiff ℝ (↑⊤) f →
            NavierStokes.RadialAlias.RadiallySupported a b f →
              NavierStokes.PressureStream.TorusPeriodicLift f →
                ∀ (s : S),
                  (NavierStokes.IntegratedMeanBalances.moment 1 fun (r : ℝ) =>
                      NavierStokes.PressureStream.torusAverage
                        (NavierStokes.PressureStream.meanPressure d a b M hab v f) (r, s)) =
                    (-(1 / 2) *
                        NavierStokes.IntegratedMeanBalances.moment 2 fun (r : ℝ) =>
                          NavierStokes.PressureStream.torusAverage f (r, s)) +
                      NavierStokes.IntegratedMeanBalances.moment 2 (NavierStokes.PressureStream.rho a b hab) / 2 *
                        NavierStokes.PressureStream.pressureMass f s
